label: relational chain enumeration
explanation: Fires on punctuation and connectives that mark steps in an explicit sequence of related clauses/items—periods, commas, semicolons, newlines, “and”, “or”, “which”, “who”, “that”, “to”, “in”, “by”—and on verbs of transfer/causation (“led”, “loved”, “went”, “feed”, “spread”, “makes”, “has”) in such chains. Strongest activations are on the relational words themselves, while punctuation firings are weaker and more numerous; it stays silent on isolated punctuation and on prose without a list/chain structure.
